remarks: Welcome to Stonebrook! This lovely home is located in Lompoc's only gated SFR community, ensuring your privacy  &  security! Step inside this beautifully maintained home and enjoy the light, bright  &  airy interior filled with abundant natural light from numerous windows. Cathedral ceilings provide a spacious feel throughout. Downstairs, you'll find a formal Living room, Family room with tile fireplace, formal Dining room, breakfast nook  &  an office/den (w/ closet) can be used as a guest bedroom.
